name: portal2-chamber-preview
description: portal2-chamber at preview cost, for checking the chain and the look, and the rung map_lighting.py --preview runs. Every value is a declared preview value in this tree: the lightmap (a 1024 atlas, Valve's Full Compile resolution, at 256 samples, denoised per chart, direct and indirect layers, directional page at 256, Blender's default light paths) and the probe volume (4 m at 256 samples) are legacy-relight-preview's, except the resolution, which is Valve's own rung (Source 2 level-design docs, Building Lighting: the default Full Compile generates 1k lightmaps, Final Compile 2k; their in-Hammer 'Preview Baked Lighting' does not bake lightmaps at all, using vertex lighting and per-pixel lights instead, so 1k is the cheapest rung that is still a lightmap bake); the directional page and the reflection probes (512 captures from 128 faces, 64 samples) are what the Portal 2 materials need to read correctly. The two caps keep a whole retail map inside a preview's cost: probe_volume.fit_limit with max_probes 50000 (the release profiles' rule) coarsens the grid rather than tracing millions of probes, and reflection_probe.placement.max_walkable 2000 (source2's) bounds placement, whose coverage passes cost O(walkable samples) serial BVH rays each: sp_a2_trust_fling reached 23,594 samples and 259 s uncapped. Since 2026-09-30 the radiosity transfer (RTRN), the SDF volume (SDFV) and the reflection probes' relight bands are not baked: moving-light GI is out of scope (user decision), so the indirect light is the bake's. A preview run records preview=true and production=false: it is not a production export. The stitched seam gate uses p99 0.004 and max 0.24 for preview runs; the release profile keeps the tool's default limits.
